name: Chicken Grape Salad
description: A refreshing salad made with cooked chicken, green grapes, celery, and toasted almonds, mixed with a creamy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine dressing ingredients in a bowl.
Toss chicken, grapes, celery, and almonds together.
Serve the chicken mixture on lettuce and garnish with parsley.

keywords: chicken salad, grape salad, creamy dressing
